issues.detail: The instructions mention error types but do not provide guidance on handling errors or edge cases.

scenarios.name: ingest-conversation-with-dreaming-instant
scenarios.rationale: Response A never uses client.add or dreaming, while Response B includes client.add with dreaming: 'instant' and a stable id but lacks an explicit wait loop for dreamingStatus to become 'done'.

scenarios.name: create-notion-connector-and-search
scenarios.rationale: Response A fully satisfies all rubric requirements with complete code, while Response B is incomplete and does not meet the rubric.

scenarios.name: build-system-prompt-from-profile
scenarios.rationale: Response B includes the required client.profile call, extraction of static and dynamic memories, and builds the system prompt string, whereas Response A only provides a placeholder template without any code to retrieve or format the memories.
